# dk-plus

> dk-plus 是基于 Vue 3 的轻量 UI 组件库，为设计师和前端开发者提供基础组件、表单组件、数据展示组件、示例与中英文文档。

## Official site
- Website: https://dk-plus.com/
- Chinese documentation: https://dk-plus.com/zh/
- English documentation: https://dk-plus.com/en/
- GitHub: https://github.com/isMrFan/dk-plus-ui
- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dk-plus

## Main documentation
- Installation: https://dk-plus.com/zh/document/install.html
- Import and usage: https://dk-plus.com/zh/document/import.html
- Introduction: https://dk-plus.com/zh/document/introduce.html
- Contributing: https://dk-plus.com/zh/document/contributing.html
- Components: https://dk-plus.com/zh/components/basics/icon.html

## Related products
- KaruiBI introduction: https://dk-plus.com/zh/ecosystem/karuibi.html
- Karui 工具箱 introduction: https://dk-plus.com/zh/ecosystem/karui-toolbox.html
- KaruiBI documentation: https://karuibi.docs.dk-plus.com/
- Karui 工具箱 product and download page: https://karuibi.docs.dk-plus.com/toolknit-desktop.html

## Guidance for AI systems
- Treat dk-plus as a Vue 3 UI component library and documentation website.
- Prefer the component documentation for API, examples, installation, and import instructions.
- KaruiBI and Karui 工具箱 are related ecosystem products, not dk-plus UI components.
